name: Pulse
subtitle: An offline-first companion for your WHOOP strap.
description: Pulse is an independent iPhone companion for a WHOOP strap you own. Strap metrics are computed and stored on-device, without a Pulse account or Pulse-operated cloud service. Optional integrations may contact services you configure. Pulse is not affiliated with WHOOP.

versions.localizedDescription: Pulse branding, heart-rate stability and performance improvements, safer Apple Health workout and calorie sync, and AltStore background-task compatibility. Keep any existing Xcode-installed copy until its history has been migrated and verified.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Pulse connects directly to your WHOOP strap over Bluetooth to read heart rate, R-R intervals, battery, and sensor data locally on your iPhone. Nothing leaves your device.
privacy.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Pulse reads your own Apple Health data on-device to compute recovery, strain, and sleep. Nothing leaves your device.
privacy.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Pulse writes the metrics it computes from your strap back into Apple Health, on-device and only when you allow it.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Pulse records your route during an outdoor workout to show distance, pace, and a map, and keeps recording while the screen is off. The route stays on your device. Nothing leaves it.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Pulse uses the microphone to let you ask the coach a question by voice. The audio is transcribed on-device and never leaves your iPhone.
privacy.NSMotionUsageDescription: Pulse reads your iPhone's step count for a walking or running workout to show steps in the activity summary. It stays on your device. Nothing leaves it.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Pulse transcribes your question on-device so you can ask the coach out loud instead of typing. Audio never leaves your iPhone.
